0022600100.text: The Utah Jazz (0-1, 12th in the West) host the New Orleans Pelicans (0-1, 8th in the West) in the Jazz's second game of the 2026-27 season and their first at home. Utah sits 5th in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, while New Orleans is 3rd in the Southwest, 1 game back, and the Pelicans' only loss so far came at home. Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot strain), Trey Alexander (out, knee bruise) and Tony Bradley (day-to-day, quadriceps strain, a game-time decision), the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Jazz lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 156-137 loss in New Orleans on April 7, 2026.
